provenance.notes: Researched definition in tools/extract/patterns/src/apg-1.mjs. Every binding was checked against the APG page; roles and key names are cross-checked mechanically against apg-skeleton.json and aria-roles.json. Arabic name is an unreviewed translation.

reference.name: APG: Carousel (Slide Show or Image Rotator) Pattern

roles.note: Or group, depending on whether it deserves a landmark.

roles.on: each slide (basic and grouped styles); the slide-picker container (grouped style)
rotation control, previous and next controls, picker buttons (grouped style)

roles.note: Replaces group and carries no aria-roledescription.

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.values: label without the word carousel; or aria-labelledby

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.values: unique name, or "3 of 10"; or aria-labelledby

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.values: changes with the action (stop / start rotation); no aria-pressed

attributes.name: aria-disabled
attributes.on: picker button of the current slide (grouped style)
attributes.note: Preferred over disabled so the button stays in the tab sequence.

keyboard.action: Move through the interactive elements of the carousel in page order; the rotation control, when present, comes first.
Move backward through the interactive elements of the carousel.

focus.entry: Rotation control first, before the rotating content. Automatic rotation stops as soon as any element inside receives keyboard focus (and while the pointer hovers) and resumes only on explicit request.
focus.restore: Activating previous, next or the rotation control does not move focus.
focus.tabStops: Basic: rotation, previous, next, plus slide content. Tabbed: one more for the tablist. Grouped: one per picker button.

data.notes: APG gives the carousel no arrow keys of its own; in the tabbed style the picker follows tabs, whose horizontal arrows mirror in RTL. In RTL the next control sits at inline-end (left) and its chevron mirrors; slide order follows the inline direction. aria-roledescription values must be translated.
